question: Can a programmed numerical agent acquire useful knowledge more efficiently by navigating its learned factual transition graph to untried actions?
hypothesis: Bitset backward reach waves from untried-action states can choose shortest known paths to missing experience. Under the same real-action/reset budgets and identical equation learner/capacity, this should improve unique evidence coverage over least-visited actions. It is programmed exploration,not invention of an exploration algorithm.
world: Frozen WSP47 map generator with new disjoint tags. Start0; only real current-state actions; reset only to0 every64 transitions. Evaluator-only admissible source-state set is minimum distance<=63 from0, because the64th action is followed by reset. No true graph/family/seed reaches the learner.
learner: Byte-identical WSP47 equation banks degree1/2/3/full and numerical first-consistent selection. Same four-bank memory in all policy arms. Actual observed facts feed graph and equation memories; no source-state injection.
numeric_policy: Known-action bitplanes and vector predecessor bit registers are updated only from actual replies. Frontier=all_states XOR(seen_action0 AND seen_action1). If current state has an untried action choose first;otherwise propagate predecessor bitsets backwards from frontier until current appears or propagation saturates (at most2**width rounds). Select first actual known outgoing edge into prior reach wave. If no path choose the same numeric least-visit fallback. Fixed masked-OR word operations implement the supplied reachability circuit; Python simulates it and decodes termination. No hidden graph/BFS oracle in candidate.
arms: same numeric equation learner with least-visit policy
independent queue-BFS policy reference on exactly candidate's learned factual graph, shadow action check without extra source calls
fully fitted observed-fact one-hot readout, same facts per policy
capacity: Each policy gets same four equation banks/action,fact bitplanes,2*N visit counters and N predecessor words of N bits. Both maintain all graph registers even when baseline ignores them. Additional graph capacity relative to WSP47 is explicit.

tests.coverage: unique actual admissible state/action pairs divided by evaluator admissible pairs; report each prefix and first full-coverage step if any
tests.prediction: 64 common unseen admissible pairs if available,otherwise unavailable; exact admissible replay and all observed recall
tests.confidence: preserve all unknown/incorrect model-relative predictions and unattainable counterfactual limits
tests.cold: equation banks canonical snapshot replay/corruption, policy source/reset/graph consistency
tests.parity: every numeric frontier action equals independent queue BFS/tie0 on same learned facts and least-visit fallback

trained_control: No new neural-training superiority comparison; frozen strongest matched batch GF2 control qualified in WSP47. Numerical and queue policy parity isolates supplied policy realization. One-hot readout fully fits actual observed replies. No SCIENTIFIC_PASS without independent unfamiliar domains/strongest neural controls.

thresholds.engineering: complete inherited full tests,new focused tests,G29/clean tree Windows/Linux; identical integer scores/trace; zero source-injection or shadow-policy mismatches
thresholds.bounded: at width8,512-step prefix,mean frontier coverage>=.75 and>=10pp over least-visit. At1024 steps,frontier mean admissible replay>=.90 over all widths/families,and every observed fact exact. Report all prefixes/failures without tuning; missing unseen cases never count as generalization.
thresholds.science: DEV_SUPPORTED if bounds pass,MIXED if valid but threshold misses,INVALID on source/parity/fact-retention violations. No learned exploration algorithm,representation invention,GI or efficiency superiority over general training.

authority: External synthetic contributor draft only;no main/merge/accepted refs,official loop,private runner,protected first-use,controller/scheduler,paid API,integration,deployment or live action.
limits: Bits/actions,finite mathematical priors and exploration algorithm remain supplied.
Coverage gain is active data selection under equal raw source budgets; computation may increase.
Pure source-graph policy ignores time remaining to next scheduled reset; retain resulting failures.
Lower-prior counterfactual certainty remains model-relative; unknown primitive/representation learning unproved.
